name: team_2017
caption:
IF OUR 2017 CHAMPIONSHIP STARTERS WERE POKÉMON 🎮🏀

✈️ Steph Curry = Latios: folds its wings to overtake jet planes. 28.1 a night in the playoffs
🐟 Klay Thompson = Barraskewda: surges forward at over 100 knots. 22.3 a night
⚡ Kevin Durant = Raikou: they say it descended with lightning. Straight from the Thunder: 28.5 a night in the playoffs, Finals MVP
🐸 Draymond Green = Toxicroak: even a scratch could prove fatal. Defensive Player of the Year, 2.0 steals a night
🦛 Zaza Pachulia = Hippowdon: a mouth almost 7 feet across. 70 starts at center

That's a team we're taking into any gym in the league. Who would you change? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If our twenty seventeen champs were Pokemon, here's the team.
By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.
beats.dlg: IT FOLDS ITS WINGS TO|OVERTAKE JET PLANES.

beats.vo: Steph in the playoffs. Twenty-eight point one points a night.
beats.dlg: STEPH IN THE PLAYOFFS:|28.1 POINTS A NIGHT!

beats.vo: It surges forward at over a hundred knots, then spears right into its prey.
beats.dlg: IT SURGES AT 100 KNOTS|AND SPEARS ITS PREY.

beats.vo: Klay, always on the attack. Twenty-two point three a night.
beats.dlg: KLAY ON THE ATTACK:|22.3 POINTS A NIGHT!

beats.vo: They say it descended with lightning.
He came to us straight from the Thunder. Twenty-eight point five a night in the playoffs, and Finals MVP.
beats.dlg: FROM THE THUNDER: 28.5|PPG AND FINALS MVP!

beats.vo: Its claws carry a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.
Defensive Player of the Year. Two steals a night, the most in the league.
beats.dlg: DEFENSIVE PLAYER OF THE|YEAR: 2.0 STEALS A NIGHT

beats.vo: Its huge mouth is almost seven feet across, with enough power to crush a car.
beats.dlg: ITS MOUTH IS ALMOST|7 FEET ACROSS!

beats.vo: Zaza did the dirty work. Seventy starts at center, five point nine boards a night.
beats.dlg: 70 STARTS AT CENTER,|5.9 REBOUNDS A NIGHT!

beats.vo: That's a team we're taking into any gym in the league.
beats.dlg: A TEAM WE'RE TAKING INTO|ANY GYM IN THE LEAGUE.

beats.vo: Who would you change? Comment below.

facts.claim: Our starters in the title-clinching Game 5 of the 2017 Finals: Kevin Durant, Draymond Green, Zaza Pachulia, Stephen Curry, Klay Thompson
Durant played for the Seattle SuperSonics / Oklahoma City Thunder 2007-2016, signed with Golden State in 2016; NBA champion and Finals MVP 2017
Green: NBA Defensive Player of the Year 2017 and NBA steals leader 2017
Latios: by folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes
Barraskewda: surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them
Raikou: they say that it descended with lightning
Toxicroak: its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal
Hippowdon: its huge mouth is almost 7 (seven) feet across; it has enough power to completely crush a car
